SessionStart.command: sh -c 'if [ -f .agents/scripts/check_code_handoff.py ]; then python3 -X utf8 .agents/scripts/check_code_handoff.py --root . --allow-template --quiet-ok; else python3 -X utf8 /shared/user/.gemini/code_handoff_tools/check_code_handoff.py --root . --allow-template --quiet-ok; fi'

hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -f .agents/scripts/code_handoff_guard.py ]; then python3 -X utf8 .agents/scripts/code_handoff_guard.py hook-pre --root .; else python3 -X utf8 /shared/user/.gemini/code_handoff_tools/code_handoff_guard.py hook-pre --root .; fi'

sh -c 'if [ -f .agents/scripts/code_handoff_guard.py ]; then python3 -X utf8 .agents/scripts/code_handoff_guard.py hook-post --root .; else python3 -X utf8 /shared/user/.gemini/code_handoff_tools/code_handoff_guard.py hook-post --root .; fi'
